scope: Lil's church and priest, Santiago Cathedral, cross, and temple scenes in B100-B104.

records.english: {SPEAKER:BC}So you're hunting mysterious treasures all over the world?{PAD}
records.speaker: Local woman
records.context: A local woman directs Lil to a knowledgeable church priest.
records.source_meaning: Hey, I overheard that you're seeking mysterious treasures scattered around the world. Is that true?
records.localization_note: Reviewed against clean Japanese and adjacent scene records; localized for American English.

records.english: {SPEAKER:BC}The priest at the nearby church knows a lot. He might have a useful lead for you.{PAD}
records.speaker: Local woman
records.context: A local woman directs Lil to a knowledgeable church priest.
records.source_meaning: The priest at the nearby church knows a great deal. He might tell you something useful.
records.localization_note: Reviewed against clean Japanese and adjacent scene records; localized for American English.

records.english: {SPEAKER:8B}Do you seek the Proof of Conquest?{PAD}
records.speaker: Priest
records.context: The priest tests Lil's resolve and explains the Proof's two Map Keys.
records.source_meaning: Could you be the ones searching for the Proof of Conquest?
records.localization_note: Reviewed against clean Japanese and adjacent scene records; localized for American English.

records.speaker: Priest
records.context: The priest tests Lil's resolve and explains the Proof's two Map Keys.
records.source_meaning: It seems I was mistaken...
records.localization_note: Reviewed against clean Japanese and adjacent scene records; localized for American English.

records.speaker: Lil Argot
records.context: The priest tests Lil's resolve and explains the Proof's two Map Keys.
records.source_meaning: Wait, what is this Proof of Conquest?
records.localization_note: Reviewed against clean Japanese and adjacent scene records; localized for American English.

records.english: {SPEAKER:8B}A prize for the ruler of the seas...{PAD}
records.speaker: Priest
records.context: The priest tests Lil's resolve and explains the Proof's two Map Keys.
records.source_meaning: It is said to be obtained by one who rules the seas...
records.localization_note: Reviewed against clean Japanese and adjacent scene records; localized for American English.

records.speaker: Lil Argot
records.context: The priest tests Lil's resolve and explains the Proof's two Map Keys.
records.source_meaning: Rules the seas? Wow, that sounds interesting!
records.localization_note: Reviewed against clean Japanese and adjacent scene records; localized for American English.

records.speaker: Lil Argot
records.context: The priest tests Lil's resolve and explains the Proof's two Map Keys.
records.source_meaning: Hey, tell us more about it.
records.localization_note: Reviewed against clean Japanese and adjacent scene records; localized for American English.

records.speaker: Kamil
records.context: The priest tests Lil's resolve and explains the Proof's two Map Keys.
records.source_meaning: Would you please tell us more?
records.localization_note: Reviewed against clean Japanese and adjacent scene records; localized for American English.

records.speaker: Lil Argot
records.context: The priest tests Lil's resolve and explains the Proof's two Map Keys.
records.source_meaning: What? Priest, do you know something about it?
records.localization_note: Reviewed against clean Japanese and adjacent scene records; localized for American English.

records.english: {SPEAKER:8B}The Proof is hard to find. These secrets demand real resolve. Are you ready?{PAD}
records.speaker: Priest
records.context: The priest tests Lil's resolve and explains the Proof's two Map Keys.
records.source_meaning: The journey to the Proof is hard. I won't tell those with halfhearted resolve. Are you prepared?
records.localization_note: Reviewed against clean Japanese and adjacent scene records; localized for American English.

records.english: {SPEAKER:02}You bet! Once my mind's made up, nothing makes me quit!{PAD}
records.speaker: Lil Argot
records.context: The priest tests Lil's resolve and explains the Proof's two Map Keys.
records.source_meaning: Leave it to me! Once I decide to do something, I never give up until the end.
records.localization_note: Reviewed against clean Japanese and adjacent scene records; localized for American English.

records.speaker: Priest
records.context: The priest tests Lil's resolve and explains the Proof's two Map Keys.
records.source_meaning: Very well.
records.localization_note: Reviewed against clean Japanese and adjacent scene records; localized for American English.

records.english: {SPEAKER:8B}The Proof's map only works when its two Map Keys are joined.{PAD}
records.speaker: Priest
records.context: The priest tests Lil's resolve and explains the Proof's two Map Keys.
records.source_meaning: What I know is that the Proof's map becomes useful only when two Map Keys are joined.
records.localization_note: Reviewed against clean Japanese and adjacent scene records; localized for American English.

records.english: {SPEAKER:8B}Each key means nothing on its own.{PAD}
records.speaker: Priest
records.context: The priest tests Lil's resolve and explains the Proof's two Map Keys.
records.source_meaning: Each key has no meaning by itself.
records.localization_note: Reviewed against clean Japanese and adjacent scene records; localized for American English.

records.english: {SPEAKER:8B}Map Keys can hide in ruins or turn up with people you'd never suspect.{PAD}
records.speaker: Priest
records.context: The priest tests Lil's resolve and explains the Proof's two Map Keys.
records.source_meaning: As you may have noticed, Map Keys may be hidden in ruins or held by unexpected people.
records.localization_note: Reviewed against clean Japanese and adjacent scene records; localized for American English.

records.speaker: Priest
records.context: The priest tests Lil's resolve and explains the Proof's two Map Keys.
records.source_meaning: I shall give you a sword.
records.localization_note: Reviewed against clean Japanese and adjacent scene records; localized for American English.

records.english: {SPEAKER:8B}Overcome the trials ahead. Help those in need.{PAD}
records.speaker: Priest
records.context: The priest tests Lil's resolve and explains the Proof's two Map Keys.
records.source_meaning: Overcome the trials placed before you and help people in trouble.
records.localization_note: Reviewed against clean Japanese and adjacent scene records; localized for American English.

records.english: {SPEAKER:8B}Give to the poor. Let go of greed, end strife, and spread peace.{PAD}
records.speaker: Priest
records.context: The priest tests Lil's resolve and explains the Proof's two Map Keys.
records.source_meaning: Do not be ruled by greed. Give to the poor, quell the source of strife, and spread peace.
records.localization_note: Reviewed against clean Japanese and adjacent scene records; localized for American English.

records.speaker: Priest
records.context: The priest tests Lil's resolve and explains the Proof's two Map Keys.
records.source_meaning: Then may God bless you all.
records.localization_note: Reviewed against clean Japanese and adjacent scene records; localized for American English.

records.english: {SPEAKER:8B}We pray to God, his Son, and his Spirit. Amen.{PAD}
records.speaker: Priest

records.source_meaning: Now let us pray. In the name of the Father, Son, and Holy Spirit... Amen.
